name: WaylandCraft-BE
author: WaylandCraft-BE contributors (GPL-3.0; upstream Java mod WaylandCraft v2.0.3 by EVV1E)
description: A Wayland compositor inside Minecraft. Phase 1 (this build): the compositor itself runs in the game process - Wayland socket + TCP loopback bridge (127.0.0.1:7231) for Termux apps (foot, weston-terminal) and the WLCF capture service (127.0.0.1:7232) for the companion app. Connect from Termux: pkg install python; python wayland-tcp-bridge.py & then WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-0 foot. In-game window rendering (RenderDragon hooks) and /wlc commands are phase 2 - see docs/PORT_NOTES.md.
